mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zed's power was not enough to eliminate Shen's allies before falling to him in battle.

Zed defeated Shen, finding strength in darkness.

Contempt for the Weak deals an additional 2% of the target's Max Health.

"Shen's equilibrium did not protect them from me -- for I have no equal."

Zed must prove the power of the shadows against Shen. Kill @spell.ZedPassive:ShenZedQuestKillCount@ enemy Champions near Shen while avoiding getting taken down by him.

"Shen represents weakness. I welcome the might of the shadows."

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage to nearby enemies.

Each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash reduces Living Shadow's Cooldown by @ShadowHitCDR@ seconds.

Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are Slowed by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Enemies hit by multiple slashes take no additional damage but are Slowed by @MoveSpeedModBonus*-100@% instead.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Contempt for the Weak</titleLeft><mainText>Whenever Zed basic attacks an enemy below 50% Health, he deals an additional @f1@% of their maximum Health as Magic Damage. This effect cannot occur on a given target more than once every 10 seconds.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zed's basic attacks against low health targets deals bonus Magic Damage. This effect can only occur once every few seconds against the same enemy champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Whenever Zed Attacks an enemy below @CurrentHealthThreshold*100@% Health, he deals an additional <magicDamage>@MaxHPDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage>. Enemy champions can only be hit once every @PerUnitCD@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_ZedPassive_Tooltip}}

This Ability deals @MonsterDamageMod*100@% damage to jungle monsters, capped at @MonsterDamageCap@ damage to epic monsters.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Contempt For the Weak</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has recently been affected by Contempt for the Weak. Subsequent attacks from Zed will not deal bonus damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.

Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zed and his <keywordMajor>Shadows</keywordMajor> throw their shurikens, each dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy they pass through, and <physicalDamage>@PassThroughDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to each additional enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipSimple:
Zed and his shadows throw their shurikens.

Each shuriken deals damage to every enemy hit.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Zed becomes Untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After @RDeathMarkDuration@ seconds, the mark triggers, dealing @RCalculatedDamage@ physical damage and repeating @RDamageAmp*100@% of all damage dealt to the target by Zed while the mark was active.

The dash leaves a Shadow behind for @RShadowDurationDisplayed@ seconds. Zed can Recast this Ability to switch positions with this Shadow.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
{{Reminder_Untargetable}}
The Shadow remains for an extra 1.5 seconds after the recast window ends.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Death Mark Shadow</titleLeft><mainText>Zed can teleport to his shadow.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Zed switches places with his shadow.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Forbidden Technique: Shadow Reaping</titleLeft><mainText>Zed has reaped a portion of an enemy champion's shadow, granting him @f1@ attack damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Shadow Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Marked for Death</titleLeft><mainText>A percent of the damage dealt by Zed will be reapplied when this mark expires.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
